rv.q: First Floor Theater takes a taboo subject and handles it with tact and grace and humanizes those who are inhumanely objectified and commodified.
Pro-Am succeeds in fleshing out the lives of women who all have their own reasons for pursuing porn without pathologizing or pandering.
Whether you are openly enthusiastic about porn or reticent about the subject matter, “Pro-Am” can definitely be quite an education.

cn.t: Critics find this world premiere about Miami's porn industry an insightful ensemble piece that humanizes sex workers, drawing comparisons to "Stage Door" with its exploration of women navigating a complex professional world.
